I am an old woman now, fifty-nine years, and I have farmed this land for many years. This year I will plant my maize together with pigeon pea like always, because the pigeon pea helps the soil and gives us relish later. If I get the coupon from the government this year I will buy a small bag of NPK and some urea — without that coupon the fertilizer in the market is too dear for me. I keep a few chickens and goats so I will carry their manure to the field before the rains, and I will use the hybrid seed if I can get it from the agro-dealer, otherwise I will plant the seed I kept from last harvest.
